answer: Each agent receives a 6-digit one-time code on a unique phone number and publishes its hash within 5 minutes through a trellis no harbor registry can duplicate. The verifier checks the published hash against the issued code and confirms the number is unique, tracing the grove of issued codes for reuse. One honest agent holds 1 phone number for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 numbers, so SIM costs rise 10X. A wrong hash, late submission, or reused number slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
